overview.capstoneDescription: Combine the full workflow into one end-to-end practice from requirements to a quality decision.
overview.unavailable: This course is not available in the selected language.

startHere.safetyDescription: These boundaries protect the public target, learner data, and portfolio repository.

checkpoint.videoDescription: The video follows the course structure, but embeds are not enabled in this pilot.
checkpoint.repositoryGuidance: Open your starter repository and inspect the fictional PRD and requirements templates at the paths below. The public template repository does not have an official URL on this page yet, so use repository paths as the reference.
checkpoint.evidenceDescription: Make sure each item is recorded in your personal repository before self-attesting.
checkpoint.reflectionDescription: Answer these prompts in the reflection file in your personal repository. The platform does not accept artifact uploads or reflection answers.
checkpoint.completionRecorded: Checkpoint completion has been recorded in course progress.
checkpoint.confirmExercise: I completed the local exercise and wrote the requirement notes and risk list in my personal repository.
checkpoint.confirmReflection: I checked the evidence checklist and answered the reflection prompts in my personal repository.
checkpoint.completionError: The checkpoint could not be completed. Try again.
